task.title: Gossipsub peer-list invariant lemmas
task.requirement: Prove universal helper lemmas for the reachable-state proof: a topic's candidate peers are unique when the peerTopics keys are unique; lookup in a fanout map returns unique peers when every stored entry has unique peers; applySubscription preserves uniqueness of peerTopics keys. Keep the original router operations and all three WellFormed conditions. This helper stage does not establish the full gossip_reachability trace requirement.
task.next: Reuse these checked helpers in gossip_reachability. Next prove preservation of all three WellFormed conditions by actual receiveRpc, join/leave/publish and heartbeat, then by Event.step and Trace.run from the empty RouterState. Do not mark the full trace requirement complete from these helpers.

EthLib.Networking.Proofs.Gossip.Reachability.fanout_nodup_of_entries : ∀ {m : List (String × List EthLib.Networking.Gossip.PeerId)},
  (∀ (entry : String × List EthLib.Networking.Gossip.PeerId), entry ∈ m → entry.snd.Nodup) →
    ∀ (t : String), (EthLib.Networking.Gossip.peersOf m t).Nodup
Axioms: #[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
EthLib.Networking.Proofs.Gossip.Reachability.topicPeers_nodup : ∀ {s : EthLib.Networking.Gossip.RouterState},
  (List.map Prod.fst s.peerTopics).Nodup → ∀ (t : String), (EthLib.Networking.Gossip.topicPeers s t).Nodup
Axioms: #[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
EthLib.Networking.Proofs.Gossip.Reachability.applySubscription_nodup : ∀ {peerTopics : List (EthLib.Networking.Gossip.PeerId × List String)} {src : EthLib.Networking.Gossip.PeerId}
  (sub : EthLib.Networking.Gossip.SubOpts),
  (List.map Prod.fst peerTopics).Nodup →
    (List.map Prod.fst (EthLib.Networking.Gossip.applySubscription src peerTopics sub)).Nodup
Axioms: #[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
